lines.trans: Sorry for my agitation earlier.

words.gloss: hour in idiom tout à l'heure

lines.trans: You do not have to apologize, Guy.
Your dog Jean Gabin is really nice.
He has a good nose, like his mistress.
It is true, you always guess the problems.
I have known my actors for a long time.
Why does everyone call you Arlette Davidson?

words.gram: masculine singular in tout le monde

lines.trans: Because I always ride a motorcycle!
You are a free and rebellious woman.
I always refused to make concessions.
You often saved me on movie shoots.
It is the job of a good agent.
Thanks for coming today, Arlette Davidson.
I will always be there for my friends.
Now, I can return to filming peacefully.
Go on, Guy, show them your immense talent!
Sorry for my agitation earlier.

examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?

examples.text: Il y a un macaron sur la table.
examples.trans: There's a macaron on the table.

meanings.note: elle a quarante ans = she is forty

meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are

meanings.note: as an interjection: bon, alors... = right, so...

meanings.en: bonne journée = have a nice day
to know a person or place
ne rien connaître à = to know nothing about

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.
Je suis seule depuis trois mois.
examples.trans: I've been on my own for three months.

meanings.en: for (a length of time, still going on)
meanings.note: with the present: je suis là depuis trois mois
je suis désolé(e) = I'm sorry; désolé! alone also works
preposition: en vacances, en huit ans
pronoun before the verb: j'en ai assez, je n'en peux plus
pour faire quoi? = to do what?
faire du vélo = to ride a bike, to cycle

meanings.en: flair, instinct, keen sense of smell

examples.trans: To have a keen nose / intuition.
A dog with a keen sense of smell.

meanings.note: quelle heure est-il? = what time is it?
à tout à l'heure = see you later
before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà

examples.text: Elle est libre dans trois semaines.

meanings.note: at liberty; not 'free of charge' (that's gratuit)

examples.trans: It was a long time ago.

meanings.note: il y a longtemps = a long time ago
for a dog: voilà ta maîtresse
merci beaucoup = thank you very much
tout le monde = everyone; il y a du monde = it's crowded
ne ... pas: not; ne ... plus: not anymore; ne ... jamais: never

examples.text: Parce que tu ne peux pas.

meanings.en: pas du tout: not at all

examples.text: Je suis là pour voir Mathias.

examples.trans: I can't take it any more.

meanings.note: je peux t'appeler? = may I call you?
je n'en peux plus = I can't take any more
être refusé(e) = to be turned down

examples.text: On peut retourner sur le plateau?
examples.trans: Can we go back to the set?

meanings.en: to go back, to return (conjugated with être)
to drive, travel by vehicle; to roll

meanings.note: agrees with the thing owned, not the owner

examples.text: Le livre est sur la table.
examples.trans: The book is on the table.

meanings.note: sur la table, sur la route
avoir du talent = to be talented
informal, one owner; ton, ta, tes

examples.text: Le tournage commence dans trois semaines.

meanings.note: from tourner un film = to shoot a film
tournez le visage = turn your face

examples.text: Ça ne va pas du tout.

meanings.note: oui à tout = yes to everything
plural tous (pronounced 'tous' with s): merci à tous
before a noun: tout le monde = everyone
singular and informal: friends, family, children, colleagues of the same age
venir de: je viens de la Côte d'Azur
venir de + infinitive: je viens d'arriver = I've just arrived
place: à Paris, à mon cours

meanings.en: au = à + le, aux = à + les
